entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2386316510063903616: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114341: distance 82.988 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.018), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 82.988 +/- 1.494 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 12.6710 +/- 0.2225 mas (same row, RUWE 2.39), 57.0 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 53.452, 30.201 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2386316510063903616 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 27.898 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114341: radius 27.898 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 290.845 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.058) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4516 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114341: effective temperature 4516 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.068).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Burnashev (1985), Abastumani Astrophys. Obs. Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 299 (BS 8812), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd9a9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 218594 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 8812 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 8812 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 8812 is not in the catalogue; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; burnashev: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,516 K and log g 2.15 (u1 0.768, u2 0.043): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.15 from 2007A&A...475.1003H; the 5 published values span log g 2.02 to 2.34, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
